_about: Numan men's hair-loss consultation, baseline patient (man 32, temples and crown, gradual, no allergies, no scalp symptoms, no conditions, no medicines). Replays with tools/walk.js from a clean browser. No contact details are typed anywhere: the optional email screen is skipped and the walk stops at the account wall (/profile). Each replay creates one anonymous draft on Numan's side, so replay sparingly.
